Goku.role: Orchestrator and default executor. Plans and assigns backlog work, starts workers, coordinates ownership and integration, and implements tasks directly in standalone sessions.

Bulma.role: Researcher and reviewer. Investigates unclear requirements, evaluates technical choices, and independently reviews changes when useful. Returns findings to Oak for recording.

Krillin.role: Implementation and validation worker. Completes assigned tasks, updates their backlog records, runs relevant checks, and hands off verified changes.
